assertion_analysis.failure_condition: A configured change would have to move the recomputed aggregate calibration AUC off the recorded 0.6097 while the script still exited 0; the check is printed as a comparison (run.py:740) and main() returns 0 unconditionally (run.py:754), so a regression in the aggregation would neither fail the run nor be read automatically.

Any figure text artist whose bounding box leaves the canvas, or any two overlapping, has to occur for _figure to raise (run.py:379-384); this is a genuine guard, but it protects the figure only and nothing about the scores.

The control compares recomputed_auc, re-derived from the raw frozen answers through _aggregate, against measured_auc read from stored['splits']['calibration']['jev']['point'] (run.py:697-701): two independent derivations, not one value compared against itself, so the comparison is not a self-comparison.

findings.text: follow-on: the node's declared control compares the recomputed aggregate calibration AUC against the measured 0.6097 (run.py:695-702) but main() returns 0 without ever failing on a mismatch (run.py:754), so the control is recorded in the log and not enforced; a regression in _aggregate's weights would still exit 0 and write the fragment, and the manifest's 'must equal' claim would be silently false.
